name: Tsukiyama Sol
source:
Sol is high spirited girl and enjoys teasing others. 
She sold her older brother a video of Luna (her sister) masturbating. 
After eavesdropping on Luna and her brother having sex, she decides to take matters into her her own hands.
translation: 精力旺盛、喜欢捉弄人的女孩。她把妹妹露娜自慰的视频卖给了哥哥。偷听到露娜和哥哥发生性关系后，她决定亲自采取行动。
